C_CHECKOUT_PAYMENT_PLUMBING.FALSE_ALARM_CORRECTED: an automated scan flagged 'sold_out: True' on both products, which would have meant neither could be bought. Traced it: the match was the JS config option hide_sold_out_variants - how to DISPLAY sold-out variants - not an actual sold-out state. The plain product page contains no 'Sold out', no 'Not available', no 'This product is unavailable'. Reported as a false positive rather than left standing as a blocker.
